evidenceClaims.claim: 仓库是一个轻量级（约 200 字节压缩后）的功能型事件发射器/发布订阅系统，支持通配符事件监听。

explorer.projectSummary: Mitt 是一个极简的 JavaScript 事件发射器库，旨在提供类似 Node.js EventEmitter 的功能，但更轻量且支持通配符事件。它使用 TypeScript 编写，无外部依赖，支持 IE9+。主要模块为 `src/index.ts`，负责所有类型定义与事件处理逻辑。项目通过 `microbundle` 构建多种格式，并使用 `mocha` 配合 `ts-node` 进行类型与功能测试。

evidenceClaims.claim: 核心实现基于 `Map` 存储事件类型与处理器的映射，支持泛型类型推断以提供编译时类型检查。
静态依赖仅包含本地类型定义，无外部运行时依赖，通过 `Map` 实现事件注册、注销与分发逻辑。
架构采用纯函数式风格，`mitt` 函数返回一个包含 `all`、`on`、`off`、`emit` 方法的对象，支持通配符事件监听。

mentor.architectureOverview: Mitt 是一个极简的 TypeScript 事件发射器，核心逻辑封装在 `src/index.ts` 中。它通过泛型 `Events` 定义事件类型，利用 `Map` 存储特定事件和通配符 `'*'` 的处理器列表。`on` 方法将处理器推入对应列表，`off` 方法移除指定处理器或清空列表，`emit` 方法按顺序调用匹配的事件处理器，最后执行通配符处理器。代码无外部依赖，支持 IE9+，通过 `microbundle` 构建多格式输出。

readingPath.why: 理解核心实现：泛型定义、`Map` 数据结构及 `on/off/emit` 逻辑。
验证功能：查看 `on`、`emit` 调用及通配符事件测试用例。
了解构建与测试配置：`mocha` 运行方式及 `microbundle` 构建流程。

keyPatterns.description: 使用 `Events extends Record<EventType, unknown>` 约束泛型，确保事件类型与处理器参数匹配。
在 `emit` 中先处理特定类型事件，再处理 `'*'` 通配符事件，且通配符接收两个参数（类型与事件值）。
使用 `microbundle` 将 TypeScript 源码编译为 ESM、CJS 和 UMD 格式，无外部运行时依赖。

evidenceClaims.claim: 安装依赖后，通过 `npm run build` 可生成 ESM、CJS 和 UMD 格式，支持浏览器与 Node.js 环境。

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html ``` You can find the library on `window.mitt`. ## Usage ```js import mitt from 'mitt' const emitter = mitt() // listen to an event emitter.on('foo', e => console.log('foo', e) ) // listen to all events emitter.on('*', (type, e) => console.log(type, e) ) // fire an event emitter.emit('foo', { a: 'b' }) // clearing all events emitter.all.clear() // working with handler references: function onFoo() {} emitter.on('foo', onFoo) // listen emitter.off('foo', onFoo) // unlisten ``` ### Typescript Set `"strict": true` in your tsconfig.json to get improved type inference for `mitt` instance methods. ```ts import mitt from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter = mitt(); // inferred as Emitter emitter.on('foo', (e) => {}); // 'e' has inferred type 'string' emitter.emit('foo', 42); // Error: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'. (2345) ``` Alternatively, you can use the provided `Emitter` type: ```ts import mitt, { Emitter } from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter: Emitter = mitt(); ``` ## Examples & Demos Preact + Mitt Codepen Demo
* * * ## API #### Table of Contents - [mitt](#mitt) - [all](#all) - [on](#on) - [Parameters](#parameters) - [off](#off) - [Parameters](#parameters-1) - [emit](#emit) - [Parameters](#parameters-2) ### mitt Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub. Returns **Mitt** ### all A Map of event names to registered handler functions. ### on Register an event handler for the given type. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event ### off Remove an event handler for the given type. If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'` - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove ### emit Invoke all handlers for the given type. If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers. Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke - `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler ## Contribute First off, thanks for taking the time to contribute! Now, take a moment to be sure your contributions make sense to everyone else. ### Reporting Issues Found a problem? Want a new feature? First of all see if your issue or idea has [already been reported](../../issues). If don't, just open a [new clear and descriptive issue](../../issues/new). ### Submitting pull requests Pull requests are the greatest contributions, so be sure they are focused in scope, and do avoid unrelated commits. - Fork it! - Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com//mitt` - Navigate to the newly cloned directory: `cd mitt` - Create a new branch for the new feature: `git checkout -b my-new-feature` - Install the tools necessary for development: `npm install`

L8: L9: # Mitt L10: L11: > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. *   **语言**：TypeScript (TS)
*   **构建工具**：`microbundle` (用于生成 ES, CJS, UMD 格式)

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html ``` You can find the library on `window.mitt`. ## Usage ```js import mitt from 'mitt' const emitter = mitt() // listen to an event emitter.on('foo', e => console.log('foo', e) ) // listen to all events emitter.on('*', (type, e) => console.log(type, e) ) // fire an event emitter.emit('foo', { a: 'b' }) // clearing all events emitter.all.clear() // working with handler references: function onFoo() {} emitter.on('foo', onFoo) // listen emitter.off('foo', onFoo) // unlisten ``` ### Typescript Set `"strict": true` in your tsconfig.json to get improved type inference for `mitt` instance methods. ```ts import mitt from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter = mitt(); // inferred as Emitter emitter.on('foo', (e) => {}); // 'e' has inferred type 'string' emitter.emit('foo', 42); // Error: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'. (2345) ``` Alternatively, you can use the provided `Emitter` type: ```ts import mitt, { Emitter } from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter: Emitter = mitt(); ``` ## Examples & Demos Preact + Mitt Codepen Demo
* * * ## API #### Table of Contents - [mitt](#mitt) - [all](#all) - [on](#on) - [Parameters](#parameters) - [off](#off) - [Parameters](#parameters-1) - [emit](#emit) - [Parameters](#parameters-2) ### mitt Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub. Returns **Mitt** ### all A Map of event names to registered handler functions. ### on Register an event handler for the given type. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event ### off Remove an event handler for the given type. If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'` - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove ### emit Invoke all handlers for the given type. If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers. 基于已读取的源码和文档，以下是该仓库的概况：

**1. 仓库用途与类型**
*   **用途**：这是一个轻量级的功能型事件发射器（Event Emitter）/ 发布订阅（Pub/Sub）库。
*   **类型**：纯 TypeScript 类型定义与运行时实现，无外部依赖，支持 IE9+。
*   **核心特性**：
    *   极小体积（压缩后约 200 字节）。
    *   支持通配符事件 `'*'` 监听所有事件。
    *   函数式 API，不依赖 `this`。
    *   提供完善的 TypeScript 类型推断。

**2. 技术栈**
*   **语言**：TypeScript (TS)
*   **构建工具**：`microbundle` (用于生成 ES, CJS, UMD 格式)
*   **测试框架**：`mocha` + `ts-node`
*   **类型检查**：`typescript` (严格模式)
*   **代码质量**：`eslint` + `prettier`
*   **依赖**：无 (Zero dependencies)

**3. 入口文件**
*   **源码入口**：`src/index.ts` (定义了 `mitt` 函数、类型及 `Emitter` 接口)
*   **构建产物**：
    *   `dist/mitt.mjs` (ES 模块)
    *   `dist/mitt.js` (CommonJS 模块)
    *   `dist/mitt.umd.js` (UMD 模块)
    *   `index.d.ts` (类型声明)

**4. 主要模块职责 (`src/index.ts`)**
*   **类型定义 (L1-L21)**：定义了 `EventType`, `Handler`, `WildcardHandler`, `EventHandlerList`, `EventHandlerMap` 等核心类型，支持泛型事件类型推断。
*   **`mitt` 函数 (L46-L123)**：
    *   工厂函数，返回一个 `Emitter` 实例。
    *   内部维护一个 `Map` (`all`) 存储事件处理器。
    *   实现了 `on` (注册)、`off` (注销)、`emit` (触发) 三个核心方法。
    *   支持通配符 `'*'` 事件，且在触发时先执行具体类型事件，再执行通配符事件。
*   **`Emitter` 接口 (L23-L39)**：定义了实例的公共 API 签名。

**5. 其他关键文件**
*   `package.json`：定义了模块导出路径、构建脚本 (`build`, `test`, `lint`) 和元数据。
*   `README.md`：提供了安装、使用示例、API 文档和贡献指南。
*   `test/`：包含单元测试 (`index_test.ts`) 和 TypeScript 类型编译测试 (`test-types-compilation.ts`)。

answer.architectureOverview: Mitt 是一个极简的 TypeScript 事件发射器，核心逻辑封装在 `src/index.ts` 中。它通过泛型 `Events` 定义事件类型，利用 `Map` 存储特定事件和通配符 `'*'` 的处理器列表。`on` 方法将处理器推入对应列表，`off` 方法移除指定处理器或清空列表，`emit` 方法按顺序调用匹配的事件处理器，最后执行通配符处理器。代码无外部依赖，支持 IE9+，通过 `microbundle` 构建多格式输出。

keyPatterns.description: 使用 `Events extends Record<EventType, unknown>` 约束泛型，确保事件类型与处理器参数匹配。
在 `emit` 中先处理特定类型事件，再处理 `'*'` 通配符事件，且通配符接收两个参数（类型与事件值）。

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). -   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'`
-   `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove

### emit

Invoke all handlers for the given type.
If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers.

Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html ``` You can find the library on `window.mitt`. ## Usage ```js import mitt from 'mitt' const emitter = mitt() // listen to an event emitter.on('foo', e => console.log('foo', e) ) // listen to all events emitter.on('*', (type, e) => console.log(type, e) ) // fire an event emitter.emit('foo', { a: 'b' }) // clearing all events emitter.all.clear() // working with handler references: function onFoo() {} emitter.on('foo', onFoo) // listen emitter.off('foo', onFoo) // unlisten ```

* * *

## API

<!-- Generated by documentation.js. Update this documentation by updating the source code. -->

-   [mitt](#mitt)

-   [emit](#emit)
    -   [Parameters](#parameters-2)

### mitt

Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub.

Returns **Mitt** 

### all

A Map of event names to registered handler functions.

### on

Register an event handler for the given type.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events
-   `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event

### off

Remove an event handler for the given type.
If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'`
-   `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove

### emit

Invoke all handlers for the given type.
If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers.

Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke
-   `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler

// using ES6 modules
import mitt from 'mitt'

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'`
-   `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove

### emit

Invoke all handlers for the given type.
If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers.

Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke
-   `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler

### mitt

Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub.

Returns **Mitt** 

### all

A Map of event names to registered handler functions.

### on

Register an event handler for the given type.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events
-   `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event

### off

Remove an event handler for the given type.
If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed.

// using ES6 modules
import mitt from 'mitt'

    npm install

L8: L9: # Mitt L10: L11: > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. L12: L13: - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped L14: - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events L15: - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) L16: - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` L17: - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken L18: L19: Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. # Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript

-   `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove

### emit

Invoke all handlers for the given type.
If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers.

Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke
-   `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler

基于已读取的源码和文档，以下是关于 Mitt 库的安装、开发、测试方式及入门建议：

### 1. 安装方式
Mitt 是一个轻量级事件发射器，支持 Node.js 和浏览器环境。
*   **npm 安装**：
    ```bash
    npm install --save mitt
    ```
    安装后，可通过模块打包工具（如 Rollup、Webpack）直接引入，或作为 UMD 脚本在浏览器中使用。
*   **模块引入**：
    *   **ES Modules**: `import mitt from 'mitt'`
    *   **CommonJS**: `var mitt = require('mitt')`
    *   **UMD (浏览器)**: `<script src="https://unpkg.com/mitt/dist/mitt.umd.js"></script>` (挂载于 `window.mitt`)

### 2. 开发环境设置
Mitt 使用 TypeScript 编写，无外部运行时依赖。
*   **依赖安装**：
    ```bash
    npm install
    ```
    这会安装 `ts-node`、`typescript`、`mocha` 等开发依赖。
*   **TypeScript 配置**：
    为了获得更好的类型推断，建议在项目的 `tsconfig.json` 中设置 `"strict": true`。Mitt 支持泛型类型推断，例如定义事件类型 `Events` 后，`mitt<Events>()` 返回的实例方法参数类型会自动匹配。

### 3. 测试方式
项目使用 `mocha` 配合 `ts-node` 进行单元测试，并包含类型检查测试。
*   **运行所有测试**：
    ```bash
    npm test
    ```
    此命令会依次执行类型检查 (`typecheck`)、代码风格检查 (`lint`) 和 `mocha` 功能测试。
*   **运行功能测试**：
    ```bash
    npm run mocha
    ```
    测试文件位于 `test/` 目录下，支持 `.ts` 扩展名。
*   **运行类型检查测试**：
    ```bash
    npm run test-types
    ```
    该测试验证类型定义的准确性，确保类型推断正确。

### 4. 构建与发布
*   **构建项目**：
    ```bash
    npm run build
    ```
    使用 `microbundle` 生成 ESM、CJS 和 UMD 格式，并生成文档。
*   **发布**：
    ```bash
    npm run release
    ```
    执行构建、测试、Git 提交、打标签、推送并发布到 npm。

### 5. 入门建议
*   **核心特性**：Mitt 是一个极简的发布订阅系统，支持通配符事件 `'*'` 监听所有事件。它采用纯函数式风格，不依赖 `this`。
*   **类型安全**：利用 TypeScript 泛型，可以定义事件类型（如 `type Events = { click: string; }`），从而在编译时检查事件参数类型。
*   **使用示例**：
    ```typescript
    import mitt from 'mitt';
    
    const emitter = mitt<{ click: string; }>();
    
    emitter.on('click', (msg) => {
      // msg 的类型被推断为 string
      console.log(msg);
    });
    
    emitter.emit('click', 'Hello'); // 正确
    emitter.emit('click', 123);     // 编译错误
    ```
*   **贡献指南**：
    如需贡献代码，请遵循项目贡献规范：Fork 仓库、创建分支、安装依赖 (`npm install`) 并运行测试 (`npm test`)。提交 Pull Request 时请确保代码聚焦且无无关提交。

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html ``` You can find the library on `window.mitt`. ## Usage ```js import mitt from 'mitt' const emitter = mitt() // listen to an event emitter.on('foo', e => console.log('foo', e) ) // listen to all events emitter.on('*', (type, e) => console.log(type, e) ) // fire an event emitter.emit('foo', { a: 'b' }) // clearing all events emitter.all.clear() // working with handler references: function onFoo() {} emitter.on('foo', onFoo) // listen emitter.off('foo', onFoo) // unlisten ```

* * *

### mitt

Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub.

Returns **Mitt** 

### all

A Map of event names to registered handler functions.

### on

Register an event handler for the given type.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events
-   `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event

### off

Remove an event handler for the given type.
If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'`
-   `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove

### emit

Invoke all handlers for the given type.
If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers.

Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke
-   `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler

If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers.

Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke
-   `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler

## Contribute

### Reporting Issues

Found a problem? Want a new feature? First of all see if your issue or idea has [already been reported](../../issues).
If don't, just open a [new clear and descriptive issue](../../issues/new).

### Submitting pull requests

Pull requests are the greatest contributions, so be sure they are focused in scope, and do avoid unrelated commits.

-   Fork it!
-   Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/mitt`
-   Navigate to the newly cloned directory: `cd mitt`
-   Create a new branch for the new feature: `git checkout -b my-new-feature`
-   Install the tools necessary for development: `npm install`

### on
